tiers.faithful: the fastest fp32-class arm (rel-RMS vs fp64 <= 3e-5, or the stock arm): the word for an fp32 engine whose identity form is fp32-tight -- every carried kernel row computes bf16 GEMMs, so today this is the stock arm in every fp32 cell
tiers.exact: a row measured BITWISE equal to the cell's stock arm AND x >= 1.00 on that card (EXACT FLOOR); else the stock arm by name
tiers.big: the FASTEST fast-admissible arm (== fast) unless its recorded peak memory exceeds the statement's recorded peak (by more than 5 % + 64 MiB, peaks under 1 GiB never count), then the fastest admissible arm whose peak does not (the statement when none does); where no peak is recorded on either side big == fast; parity (within 5 %) keeps the incumbent word; the rowpair schedule row is the memory tier's lever above any forward row and is not a cell winner by itself

default_rule: select(row=<name>) serves exactly that row (its own launch cell) or raises Refusal by name with the fallback row (never a silent substitute); select(row='fast'|'faithful'|'exact'|'big') is the OPT-IN tier word resolving to the cell's measured winner for the caller's stack (the reference stack's winner flagged stack_measured=False elsewhere); a kit keeps its current binding until it names a row or a tier word -- nothing in this table changes what an existing caller of the wrapped core modules (kernels.fpf_transition, kernels.fpf_transition_v2, kernels.lnl_fused, attn.pair_fused, mem.rowpair) executes
exact_vouch_rule: an EXACT vouch is stack- and size-specific: a cell's kernel exact arm is served under the tier word only on a stack listed in the cell's vouched_on (measured bitwise there) and only for n_tokens >= coverage[family].exact_floor[stack] (the smallest size from which every vouch measurement on that stack was bitwise); elsewhere select('exact') refuses by name (exact_vouch_not_recorded_on_<stack> | exact_vouch_below_<n>_tokens_on_<stack>) with the module floor as the fallback -- fast / faithful / big are tolerance-class words and are unaffected
exact_rows_rule: the exact tier also honours the card's cuBLAS piece-remainder rule, ONE statement for the family kept in attn/pair_fused_cells.json "exact_rows" (piece 'transition'): select('exact', rows_count=<rows>) refuses BY NAME (exact_rows_below_min_rows_on_cc_<cc> | exact_rows_above_max_rows_on_cc_<cc>, the module floor as the fallback) where the call's row count lies outside the card's served set (cc 8.0: rows >= 4096, and from 1048544 rows a remainder rows mod 2^20 within [161424, 1040384]); transition() always passes the row count; a card without an entry (9.0) and the tolerance-class words are unaffected
exact_rule: EXACT FLOOR x1.00: a row is a cell's exact winner only where it is measured bitwise equal to the stock arm AND x >= 1.00 on that card; the carried kernels reproduce the stock rounding points but not cuBLAS's summation order, so most cells' exact word is the stock arm by name; flash_sm90a's bitwise class is recorded per cell where measured
capture_rule: compile (capture_safe=false) is never a graph cell's winner and select(capture=True) refuses it by name; af3_fused autotunes at its first call per shape bucket: select(capture=True) serves it with the word warm_before_capture (one eager call per (rows bucket, c, hidden, residual) before capture)

A100:torch2.11.0+cu128/3.6.0.rule: the exact tier serves the row only when min_remainder <= (rows mod modulus) <= max_remainder (rows = the call's row count: N^2 for pair families, N for single); outside the band the statement is the exact tier BY NAME
A100:torch2.11.0+cu128/3.6.0.source: kit table (an AF3-family kit's cc 8.0 exact vouch on this stack, 2026-09-12): byte-identical vs its module when the last 2^20-row piece's remainder is >= 161,424 rows (smallest passing remainder measured) and fails at 8,208; remainders in between not swept -> the conservative bound; upper margin 2^20 - 8192
